date:babylonian-captivity@a83c0d.note: The text gives seventy years of servitude but no start or end year. The BC dates depend on outside chronology.

date:chaldean-raiders-take-captives-from.note: jer.52.28 dates these captives to Nebuchadnezzar's seventh year; 2kgs.24.12 dates Jehoiachin's surrender to his eighth. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:chaldeans-withdraw-from-jerusalem@6.note: jer.37.5 gives no date for the withdrawal. 2kgs.25.2 dates the siege to Zedekiah's eleventh year. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:cyrus-decrees-the-rebuilding-of-the.note: 2chr.36.22 dates the decree only to Cyrus's first year. The BC year (536 here, 538 in most modern scholarship) depends on outside dating.

date:daniel-interprets-nebuchadnezzar-s-.note: dan.2.1 dates the dream to Nebuchadnezzar's second year. The BC year depends on outside dating of his accession.

date:fall-of-babylon@cb499f.note: dan.5.30 gives only the night Belshazzar was slain, with no year. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:fall-of-jerusalem@f95be2.note: 2kgs.25.8 dates Nebuzaradan's arrival to Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year, fifth month. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:first-deportation-to-babylon@95f15f.note: dan.1.1 dates the siege that began the deportation to Jehoiakim's third year. The BC year depends on outside dating of his reign.

date:jeconiah-released-from-prison@6de43.note: 2kgs.25.27 dates the release to the thirty-seventh year of Jehoiachin's captivity, when Evilmerodach began to reign. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:jehoiakim-becomes-nebuchadnezzar-s-.note: jer.25.1 equates Jehoiakim's fourth year with Nebuchadnezzar's first. 2kgs.24.1 gives no year. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:nebuchadnezzar-besieges-jerusalem@6.note: 2kgs.25.1-2 dates the siege to Zedekiah's ninth year, tenth month, lasting to his eleventh year. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:nebuchadnezzar-defeats-pharaoh-nech.note: jer.46.2 dates the battle to Jehoiakim's fourth year. The BC year depends on outside dating of his reign.

date:nebuzar-adan-carries-away-745-jews@.note: jer.52.30 dates this deportation to Nebuchadnezzar's twenty-third year. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:reign-of-nebuchadnezzar@1434e3.note: jer.25.1 gives only his first year, Jehoiakim's fourth. The end of the reign is not dated in Scripture; both BC years depend on outside chronology.

date:second-deportation-to-babylon@9bd2a.note: 2kgs.24.12 dates Jehoiachin's surrender to the eighth year of his reign. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:the-glory-of-the-lord-leaves-the-te.note: ezek.8.1 dates the vision, which includes the departure, to the sixth year, sixth month. The BC year depends on outside dating of the exile.

date:third-deportation-to-babylon@f95be2.note: 2kgs.25.8 dates Nebuzaradan's arrival to Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year, fifth month. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:zedekiah-goes-to-babylon@2ba116.note: jer.51.59 dates the journey to Zedekiah's fourth year. The BC year depends on outside dating of his reign.

date:zedekiah-rebels-against-nebuchadnez.note: 2kgs.24.20 gives no year for the rebellion. 2kgs.25.1 dates the siege that followed to Zedekiah's ninth year. The BC year depends on outside dating.

occurred-at:chaldean-raiders-take-captiv.note: The raiders were sent against Judah, where the captives were taken (2kgs.24.2). Babylon is only where Jehoiachin was carried (2kgs.24.15).

occurred-at:chaldeans-withdraw-from-jeru.note: The Chaldeans left Jerusalem when Pharaoh's army came out of Egypt. The withdrawal happened at Jerusalem, not in Egypt.

occurred-at:cyrus-decrees-the-rebuilding.note: 2chr.36.22 has Cyrus proclaim throughout his kingdom and names no city. Babylon comes from outside history, not from this verse.

occurred-at:fall-of-jerusalem>riblah_100.note: The fall came at Jerusalem (2kgs.25.8-10). Riblah is where Zedekiah was taken and judged (2kgs.25.6), a separate event.

occurred-at:first-deportation-to-babylon.note: Captives were taken from Jerusalem (dan.1.1). Dan.1.2 names only the land of Shinar; that Shinar means Babylon is an outside identification.
Nebuchadnezzar came unto Jerusalem and besieged it, and the Lord gave Jehoiakim into his hand there (dan.1.1-2).

occurred-at:nebuchadnezzar-defeats-phara.note: The battle was at Carchemish, which lay by the river Euphrates (jer.46.2). The river is a nearby location, not the site named.

occurred-at:nebuzar-adan-carries-away-74.note: jer.52.30 says Nebuzar-adan carried them away and names no place. Babylon as their destination is an inference from outside history.

occurred-at:second-deportation-to-babylo.note: 2kgs.24.15 has Jehoiachin carried to Babylon. The capture was at Jerusalem (2kgs.24.10-12), so Babylon is the destination, not the site.

occurred-at:the-glory-of-the-lord-leaves.note: The glory of the LORD departed from the threshold of the house (ezek.10.18) and went up from the midst of the city (ezek.11.23).
ezek.11.23 has the glory stand on the mountain east of the city. Mount of Olives is an identification from outside Scripture; the verse does not name it.

occurred-at:third-deportation-to-babylon.note: 2chr.36.20 says the survivors were carried away to Babylon; 2kgs.25.11 has Nebuzaradan carry away the people from Jerusalem. Babylon is the destination.
Nebuzaradan came unto Jerusalem (2kgs.25.8), and the people left in the city were carried away from it (2kgs.25.11).

participated-in:daniel_975>fall-of-babyl.note: In the event's own chapter (Dan 5), Daniel is brought in, reads the writing that foretells the fall, and is rewarded. He has no part in the slaying itself (5:30).

participated-in:ezekiel_1237>the-glory-o.note: Ezekiel sees the departure in a vision (ezek.11.24) and acts in nothing. He is the seer, not a participant in the event.

participated-in:god_1324>the-glory-of-th.note: The glory of the LORD, God's own presence, departs from the house and goes up from the city.

participated-in:jehoiakim_1085>chaldean-.note: The bands were sent against him (2kgs.24.2), so he was the target. The text does not show him taking part in the seizure of captives.

participated-in:jeremiah_853>zedekiah-go.note: Jeremiah writes the book against Babylon and charges Seraiah, who goes with Zedekiah, to read it there (51:59-61). He acts in the episode but does not make the journey.

participated-in:nebuchadnezzar_2167>firs.note: Nebuchadnezzar came unto Jerusalem and besieged it, and the Lord gave Jehoiakim into his hand (dan.1.1-2). He acted in the taking.

participated-in:nebuchadnezzar_2167>fall.note: Nebuchadnezzar came against Jerusalem with all his host (2kgs.25.1). His servant Nebuzaradan took the city in his nineteenth year (2kgs.25.8-9).

participated-in:nebuchadnezzar_2167>nebu.note: Nebuzar-adan carried the 745 away, dated to Nebuchadnezzar's year (jer.52.30). He acted as the king's servant (2kgs.25.8); the king is not shown on the spot.

participated-in:nebuchadnezzar_2167>thir.note: The king of Babylon, Nebuchadnezzar in his nineteenth year (2kgs.25.8), smote the captured leaders at Riblah (2kgs.25.21).

participated-in:nebuzar-adan_2169>fall-o.note: Nebuzaradan came unto Jerusalem and burned the house and the houses (2kgs.25.8-9). The army under him broke down the walls (2kgs.25.10).

participated-in:nebuzar-adan_2169>nebuza.note: jer.52.30: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away 745 persons of the Jews.

participated-in:nebuzar-adan_2169>third-.note: Nebuzaradan carried away the people left in the city (2kgs.25.11) and brought the captured leaders to Riblah (2kgs.25.20).

participated-in:nehushta_2174>second-dep.note: 2kgs.24.8 names Jehoiachin's mother as Nehushta. She went out with him (2kgs.24.12) and was carried to Babylon (2kgs.24.15).

participated-in:pharaoh-nechoh_2337>nebu.note: jer.46.2 names the army of Pharaohnecho king of Egypt as the force Nebuchadnezzar smote at Carchemish.

participated-in:pharaoh_2336>chaldeans-w.note: The text names Pharaoh's army, not Pharaoh himself, coming out of Egypt (jer.37.5, 37.7). Acting through his army is probably meant.

participated-in:zedekiah_1950>chaldeans-.note: Zedekiah sends to Jeremiah for prayer while the Chaldeans are at the city (jer.37.3). They then depart (jer.37.5), but he is not named in their withdrawal.

participated-in:evil-merodach_1233>jecon.note: 2kgs.25.27: Evilmerodach king of Babylon lifted up the head of Jehoiachin out of prison.
